text:
sam: Heads-up: deploying routebalancer v1.9.0 at 02:15 UTC. Ramp: 0.5% -> 3% -> 12% with 10m holds. Flag: route_balancer_v1.9.0_enabled. Pin cohort to `balancer_version=1.9.0`.

tara: Copy. Can we start keyed so internal traffic is excluded?

sam: Yes — keyed=true. @deploy-bot start at 02:15 and post hold updates.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout 3955556666. Running: ffctl enable route_balancer_v1.9.0 --cohort=keyed:0.5% --param balancer_version=1.9.0. Monitoring p95,errors,quality. Posting updates every 3m.

deploy-bot: (3m) 0.5% up. p95 220ms (baseline 210ms), errors 0.02%, quality delta 0.0% — proceeding to 3% in 2m.

tara: Proceed. I'll run the smoke prompt deck now.

vik: If quality delta > 1.0% or errors > 0.3% during any hold, abort and rollback to 1.8.7.

deploy-bot: (hold) at 3%: p95 +12% vs baseline, errors 0.18%, quality delta -1.4% — holding and paging owners.

sam: Hold. Do not progress. Tara, can you paste a couple failing traces to #release-rollback? I'll check tokenizer and route config.

tara: Posted two failing prompts (entity normalization truncation).

deploy-bot: Rollback queued pending human confirmation.

sam: Executing disable now: ffctl disable route_balancer_v1.9.0 --reason="quality regression". Rolling back to 1.8.7 and disabling flag.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Flag set to 0%. Traffic routed back to balancer_version=1.8.7. Summary and traces posted to #release-logs.

vik: Please add a preflight gate: block ramps past 3% if eval delta > 0.8% (or fail fast).

sam: Will add to the deploy checklist and schedule a hotfix window tomorrow morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:
